issue_title: [Bug] Todo.from_dict accepts invalid id values (0, negative, non-integer floats)
fix_summary: Added validation in Todo.from_dict to ensure id is a positive integer and reject non-integer float values
acceptance_criteria_met: Todo.from_dict({'id': 0, 'text': 'x'}) raises ValueError with 'id must be positive'
Todo.from_dict({'id': -1, 'text': 'x'}) raises ValueError with 'id must be positive'
Todo.from_dict({'id': 1.5, 'text': 'x'}) raises ValueError about non-integer value
